India-US cooperation on AI and critical minerals highlighted

An Indian Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) official stated that the private sector is crucial for advancing cooperation between India and the United States in the fields of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and critical minerals. This collaboration aims to strengthen bilateral ties and potentially enhance technological and resource access for both nations.
